title: Symbolon Login Lease v1
description: Machine-checkable shape for a Symbolon Protocol v1 Login Lease. Tracks symbolon-protocol-v0.1.md §3. A document validating against this schema is well-formed; it still MUST be subjected to the §4 verification algorithm before any session is created.

v.description: Protocol version. MUST be 1 for this schema.

jti.description: Globally unique lease ID. ULID or UUIDv7.

vault_id.description: Stable identifier for the issuing Vault. See spec §7.

subject_id.description: Verifier-known Subject identifier. SHOULD be pairwise per Verifier (see open question §13.5).

app_id.description: Verifier app identifier the lease is bound to.

device_id.description: Subject user-agent device identifier this lease is bound to.

not_after.description: RFC 3339 timestamp, UTC, 'Z' suffix. SHOULD be <= not_before + 3600s (spec §9.5).

max_session_ttl_sec.description: Hard cap (seconds) for the session the Verifier may create.

allowed_actions.description: Action scope. Use ['*'] for unrestricted within app_id.

geo_constraint.description: Optional geographic / network constraint. If present, the request origin MUST match every non-empty subfield (AND across subfields, OR within each subfield).

ephemeral_pubkey.description: Ed25519 public key for this lease, multibase base58btc ('z' prefix).

nonce_challenge_required.description: If true, Verifier MUST issue a random challenge and require a signature with the matching ephemeral private key.

extensions.description: Implementation-defined fields. Unknown extension keys MUST be ignored by Verifiers.

vault_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the JCS (RFC 8785) canonicalization of this object with vault_signature removed. Multibase base58btc ('z' prefix).
